jobs.occupation: Principal Research Scientist - Product Development (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: As Principal Research Scientist – Formulation Development, you will join Elanco’s Synthetic Technical Development team in Monheim to lead formulation development for animal health drug products across the full product development life cycle.In this role, you will provide scientific and technical leadership for Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) products and other dosage forms as needed, solve complex formulation challenges, and guide internal teams and external partners from early development through commercial scale-up.Your Responsibilities:- Lead the design, development, and optimization of Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) formulations, including tablets and medicated chewables, from enabling formulations and prototype development through final product design and process scale-up and transfer to manufacturing sites.- Apply advanced formulation and process expertise in granulation (wet and dry), blending, compression, coating, bioavailability enhancement, controlled release, taste masking, and Quality by Design (QbD) to address complex technical challenges.- Partner cross-functionally with R&D, manufacturing and quality, and regulatory teams to deliver global development milestones for animal health drug products.- Select and provide technical oversight to external partners, including Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and Contract Development & Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs),, while ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Health, Safety and Environment (HSE), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).- Author and review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) technical sections for regulatory submissions, assess new technologies and in-licensing opportunities, and mentor subject matter experts and developing scientists.What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):- Education level — Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or a related scientific field required; PhD preferred- A minimum of 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical drug product development and process scale-up with a PhD, or 15 years with a Master’s degree- Strong experience in Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) formulation development and manufacturing processes, including tabletsand/or chewable dosage forms- Strong working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and global regulatory guidelines, including Veterinary International Cooperation on Harmonisation (VICH) and International Council for Harmonisation (ICH)- Proven success bringing pharmaceutical products from laboratory development to commercial scale- Leadership and team skills: ability to operate and lead development activities in a global matrix organization- Excellent written and spoken EnglishWhat will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):- Experience developing additional dosage forms such as liquids, topicals, or parenterals- Experience in process transfer between R&D and Manufacturing Sites- Experience selecting and managing external development or manufacturing partners, including CROs, CDOs, or CMOs- Experience mentoring technical talent and leading subject matter experts in a matrix environmentAdditional Information:Travel: 10–15%Location: Monheim, Germany

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

We’re looking for a product engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 40+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

We have has raised more than €4M, including a €2.9M seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and a strong bench of angels. We already serve 400+ customers across Denmark, Germany, and Switzerland, and we're just getting started.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

• A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• An inspiring people leader and coach.

• A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

About Chr. Olesen Group

Chr. Olesen Group is a leading international distribution company specializing in vitamins, minerals, and active pharmaceutical ingredients for the feed, food, pharma, and technical industries. With products sourced primarily from Asia, we proudly serve esteemed customers worldwide. As a family-owned business led by the 4th and 5th generations, we combine significant turnover with a close-knit team, making our roles both challenging and rewarding. Discover more about our fascinating history at www.chr-olesen.dk.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Finance Manager to join our headquarters in Gentofte, Denmark.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will play a key role in Group Finance, acting as the day-to-day link between headquarters and our overseas subsidiaries.

The position combines financial controlling, reporting, coordination of budgeting and closing activities, and financial analysis with the implementation and follow-up of Group finance standards, procedures, and ad hoc projects.

Working closely with the CFO and local finance teams, you will help integrate Group finance standards and procedures into daily operations in HQ, and overseas, and monitor adherence, and coordinate improvements.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the day-to-day finance link between HQ and the overseas (LATAM. US and Turkey), teams, facilitating communication, coordination, and follow-up in partnership with local finance colleagues and regional finance leadership.

• Coordinate HQ requirements for budgeting, forecasting, and ongoing financial follow-up with local finance teams, reviewing inputs for consistency with Group standards.

• Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting from local teams and coordinate follow-up to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Group reporting requirements.

• Coordinate Group closing requirements and timelines with local finance teams and support the resolution of issues during month-end and year-end closing.

• Work closely with regional finance leadership, local colleagues, external accountants, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve day-to-day finance issues and escalate unresolved matters to the CFO.

• Act as a key financial sparring partner to the CFO and provide management with financial insights and analysis to support decision-making.

• Coordinate the implementation and integration of Group finance standards, procedures, and internal controls in LATAM and the US, monitor adherence, and follow up on corrective actions with local teams.

• Develop and maintain Group finance standards.

• Implementation and maintenance of group closing system.

• Work hands-on in Microsoft Business Central and contribute to the effective use and development of the system across the finance function.

• Take ownership of a broad range of ad hoc financial analyses, projects, and tasks arising as the Group and its international activities develop.

Key Skills for Success

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An HD in Accounting/Finance or a relevant Master’s degree is also highly valued.

• Solid experience within financial controlling, accounting, finance, or a similar role, preferably within an international organization.

• Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, month-end and year-end closing, and financial analysis.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial processes, and internal controls, with the ability to translate Group standards and procedures into consistent day-to-day practices.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Business Central.

• Ability to take ownership, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• A proactive and pragmatic approach, with the flexibility to handle both recurring responsibilities and a broad range of ad hoc assignments.

• Experience in Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Why Chr. Olesen Group?

• Global Exposure: Work with a diverse team across multiple countries and gain invaluable international experience.

• Career Growth: We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that leverages cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.

Are You Our New Colleague?

If you are a proactive and analytical finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, working internationally, and being close to the business, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application here.

10. December 2026

_Are you a passionate, service-minded professional looking for your next opportunity with international exposure?

_**About The Job

**We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfil their financial aspirations to make an impact. That is why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalized experience.

We are looking for our next Client Service Associate to join our Client Service team located at our HQ in Copenhagen. In this role you will take part in providing first-in-class client experience in an environment where digital engagement is ever changing. We are dealing with a great variety of clients from individuals to institutional. As our new Client Service Associate, you will be assisting clients with a broad array of queries ranging from trading to funding related questions.

Our Client Service team consists of 200+ employees spread across 9 locations servicing all client types. The team’s overall purpose is to drive the global distribution and services of products towards clients of Saxo across all entities throughout the world.

A few words from our Head of Client Service, Cæcilie Marie Sommer on the role in her team:

"Working in Client Services is a great opportunity to learn about investments, build experience in the financial services industry and develop professional skills in communicating with all types of clients around the globe".

**Responsibilities

**As our new Client Service Associate, you take pride in walking the extra mile to ensure that our clients’ needs and requests are fulfilled and answered. However, there are no expectations for you to be able to answer all the questions from the day one. We will provide the needed onboarding and continuously train you to be able to independently assist the clients.

Becoming a part of Client Service, you act as an ambassador for Saxo and therefor it is essential that you always thrive to deliver a best-in-class client experience and leaving the clients on a positive note.

**Your Tasks Will Include

**

• Advise and assist our clients on our wide product range across all asset classes

• Act as our client facing specialist with extensive knowledge of our industry leading trading platforms

• Ensure regulatory compliance through execution of global governance

• Always act in the best interest of our clients and Saxo

• Increase client digital interaction with Saxo

**Your Profile

**You have great communication skills with excellence in both conveying specialist knowledge as well as simple instructions. You are motivated by clear goals and thrive with having transparent performance indicators

Moreover, we are looking for you who

• Has 2+ years of experience in a client-facing role

• Preferably have an education related to service, finance, business or similar

• Have knowledge of the financial industry and products

• Are fluent in Danish as well as English. And a third language is a plus

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

jobs.occupation: Security Integration Officer - Help Protecting Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: 18-11-2026

Contract type: Local, Esbjerg

Appetizer

Do you want to turn cybersecurity requirements into clear governance that people can actually follow? Are you excited by the challenge of protecting both enterprise and industrial environments? Do you enjoy partnering with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and driving risk-reducing actions through to completion? In this role, you will help implement cybersecurity policies and governance, ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to make, apply now and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Your new team

One IT Denmark delivers the IT and digital services that keep the business running onshore and offshore. We work closely with colleagues across the organization to improve reliability, introduce new solutions, and strengthen cybersecurity.

The department includes four teams: Business Partnering, IT Operations, Project & Performance, and Cybersecurity & Industrial. Together, we support TotalEnergies EP Denmark (TEPDK) and TotalEnergies Upstream Denmark (TUDK) operations and development projects.

In a department with different nationalities and backgrounds, we believe in the power of diversity and collaboration. People are the key to our success; we invest in development and foster an atmosphere of innovation.

Would you like to help shape better energy?

Send your application as soon as possible. For any questions, you are more than welcome to reach out to Human Resources (HR) Recruitment on ep.dk-recruitment@totalenergies.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Activities

Key areas of responsibility

Cybersecurity governance and support

• Help shape and maintain local cybersecurity governance, aligned with group standards and Danish regulations, across both enterprise and industrial systems

• Turn security requirements into practical guidance, templates, and ways of working that teams can apply in day-to-day operations

• Support incident response by investigating and following up on cybersecurity incidents, working with central Headquarters (HQ) teams, local teams, and external service providers.

• Perform systematic vulnerability assessment and vulnerability management

• Assist definition and follow-up on cybersecurity requirements in 3rd party contracts to manage supply chain related risks.

Cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Manage cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Identify gaps against security requirements and agree on feasible remediation actions with system owners and business stakeholders

• Build and track remediation plans for vulnerabilities and approved exceptions, and report progress to stakeholders

• Advise project teams and vendor/contract owners on cybersecurity requirements and risk-reducing controls

Operational procedures and security

• Help define and improve security procedures and technical controls (hardware and software) to reduce risk

• Strengthen incident readiness and response by helping define roles, playbooks, tooling, training and supporting response activities during major incidents

• Contribute to training, presentations, and communications to raise cybersecurity awareness in the organization

• Collaborate with teams in central Headquarters (HQ) and other affiliates and share feedback from the Denmark organization

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 669,750 - DKK 893,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

Who we are looking for

• BSc in Information Security (or similar) or at least 10 years of IT experience

• Minimum 5 years of cybersecurity experience

• Knowledge of, and preferably practical experience with, NIS2 directive related Danish Executive Order on resilience and preparedness in the energy sector (No. 260)

• Experience with Industrial Information Systems / Operational Technology (OT) environments is an advantage

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to translate requirements into practical guidance

• Structured, analytical approach to risk-, incident-, and vulnerability management
